{"action":"done","summary":"All 220 tests pass (including 4 acceptance_public.py tests). The existing TaggedCache implementation in src/cachetools/tagged.py already correctly implements all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: put(key,value,tags=()) with deep copy on input/output, tags validation (rejects bare strings, non-string entries), key hashing
- R02: invalidate(tag), LRU eviction without stale memberships, get refreshes recency, len counts live entries
- R03: maxsize validated as positive non-bool int; invalid replacement preserves state
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all') with union/intersection semantics, empty tags returns 0, validates before mutation
- R05: resize(maxsize) preserves entries and LRU order, shrinking evicts LRU, growing doesn't evict, maxsize property
- R06: Tags consumed as generators (via list()), detached returns via deepcopy
- R07: timer=None defaults to time.monotonic, put(ttl=None) no expiration, finite nonnegative int/float (not bool) sets expiry, TTL=0 immediately expired, invalid TTL raises ValueError before mutation
- R08: Expired entries removed before get/put/len/resize/invalidation without touching recency of surviving entries, tag invalidation counts only live entries

No code changes were needed - the implementation was already correct."}
